info.title: 토스증권 Open API
info.description: 토스증권 트레이딩 Open API 의 REST 스펙입니다. 실시간 체결·호가·본인 주문 이벤트 스트리밍은 REST 가 아닌 웹소켓 API(`wss://openapi-ws.tossinvest.com/ws/v1`)로 제공되며, 별도의 AsyncAPI 3.0 문서 (https://openapi.tossinvest.com/openapi-docs/latest/asyncapi.json)가 실시간 스펙의 source of truth 입니다.

note: PLACEHOLDER -- see docs/operations/TOSS-API-GAP-ANALYSIS.md for the extracted endpoint/schema summary this repository actually relies on. The full verbatim OpenAPI document (tags, paths, components/schemas) was provided by the user directly in-conversation on 2026-08-27 and is reproduced in full in the session transcript. This placeholder file exists so a future session knows the source location and can request the full JSON be re-pasted or re-fetched (network access to openapi.tossinvest.com remains blocked from this environment) rather than assuming it is missing entirely.
